reviewer_notes: Paper studies one plant (A1). The energy characterization produced three linear baseline regressions E = Eo + m*P (M1 electricity, M2 coal, M3 gas), each reporting a correlation coefficient, and three derived consumption-index intensity ratios (M4 electricity, M5 coal, M6 gas) yielding energy-saving figures at a 77% load factor. Estimation method for the regressions is not stated (correlation coefficients reported but no OLS statement). The coal baseline's poor fit is explicitly attributed to unmeasured steam — recorded both as mechanism K1 (observability gap) and as a study limitation with also_constrains_model=true. Much of the paper concerns LCA/environmental impacts, which are outside the energy-performance-model scope.
